dedupe_keys.name: itu r report bt 2526 2 field trials of terrestrial multimedia mobile broadcasting systems 2025

description: This ITU-R report collects summary descriptions of field trials in different countries of new technologies for terrestrial multimedia broadcasting to mobile receivers in the broadcasting bands. It reviews the standardisation status of LTE-based 5G terrestrial broadcast, 5G new radio multicast and broadcast (NR MBS) and ATSC 3.0, initiatives that promote trials, and the trials themselves, with Annex 1 on 5G NR MBS trials in Beijing, Shanghai (a trial station on a TV tower) and Nanjing and on LTE-based 5G terrestrial broadcast in China, including high-tower deployment results and capability checks in a commercial scenario. Producer: ITU-R Study Group 6 under Question ITU-R 132/6; this is revision 2 dated September 2025, 220 pages. Coverage: trials in several countries, with a large part from China. Access: a free PDF on the ITU website. Licence and cost: ITU copyright with no reproduction without written permission; free to read. Caveats: the report says new trials will be added, so it will be updated, and the trial descriptions are summaries supplied by administrations. Simulation uses: trial coverage and QoS results give validation data for broadcast and multicast coverage and capacity models. Related record: EBU TR 044 on 4G and 5G broadcast trials (case_study-ebu-tr-044-4g-5g-broadcast-trials).
